arguments.query: code review approvals required before merge to main branch

answer:179dc4d4-35c8-494a-baf7-ea35865a6: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
